title: VelvetySour Italian Emmentaler Cheese PestoRobataGrill
description: A meal-prep Italian dish featuring emmentaler cheese sautéed with sugar-free-friendly ingredients for a velvety and sour flavor profile, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat Robata grill to high heat.
Chop almonds and mince garlic. If using pesto base, mix it with a bit of dairy-free olive oil until smooth.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add emmentaler cheese first, then add pesto if using, followed by minced garlic and lemon zest.
Stir continuously until the mixture starts to thicken and becomes velvety-smooth, about 3-5 minutes.
Once fully smooth, remove from heat and fold in sliced almonds.
Serve immediately on a Robata grill for maximum freshness and flavor.
